bets.name: Spain Group H Crown
bets.comment: Across 30,000 simulated tournaments Spain top Group H 65% of the time (and reach the knockouts 95%). Fair odds 1.53 — group-winner markets are often lazier than match odds, so value hides here.

bets.name: Mexico Group A Crown
bets.comment: Across 30,000 simulated tournaments Mexico top Group A 65% of the time (and reach the knockouts 99%). Fair odds 1.55 — group-winner markets are often lazier than match odds, so value hides here.

bets.name: Norway Ticket to the Dance
bets.selection: Norway to qualify for the knockout stage
bets.comment: FIFA #31 Norway make the last 32 in 81% of simulations — top two in the group or one of the eight best thirds. Fair odds 1.23; qualification markets on mid-tier sides are usually priced off name value, not the maths.

bets.name: Germany Quarter Club
bets.comment: The sim sends Germany (FIFA #10) to the last 8 in 33% of 30,000 tournaments — fair odds 3. Outside the top seeds the "to reach the quarters" market routinely pays better than that.

bets.name: Belgium Outright Steal
bets.selection: Belgium to win the World Cup
bets.comment: The outright market implies Belgium win the cup 2% of the time, but our 30,000 bracket-aware simulations make it 3% — 33% more often, mostly thanks to a kind draw path. Long-shot, but the price is wrong.
